we have designed and implemented a system that can automatically unfold a piece of cloth on a working table.
we developed a vision system for the unfolding of highly non-rigid objects on a table by one manipulator.

the detection of the fabric corners, which are the most important features of the folded piece of fabric.
the following problems: how to detect and locate the ROIs in a folded piece of cloth; how to classify them according to the number of folds and how to unfold them.

the following aspects: (1) the detection of the corners of a piece of fabric lying on a table, (2) the classification of the corners, (3) the determination of the orientation of the piece of fabric and (4) the unfolding process.

a new vision-based system is presented for the unfolding of a piece of fabric by a manipulator on a table.
this paper proposes a new method to unfold a piece of cloth with a single robot arm.
this method is a very useful and effective tool to be used for the unfolding process of highly non-rigid objects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a method to unfold a fabric on a table by one manipulator using a vision system to detect the corners of the cloth and a force sensor for the detection of the contact force of the cloth on the table and the robot.
we are able to unfold a fabric with one robot arm and with machine vision as the only feedback.
the proposed method is able to detect, evaluate, classify and localize the ROIs on the fabric.

we have shown that the proposed approach is capable of detecting the ROIs with high reliability and accuracy.
the proposed method can detect the corners of a piece of fabric lying on a working table.
